praises: 64GB + RTX 5060 in a 1.55kg 15-inch chassis is close to a mobile workstation without the weight
Panther Lake Ultra 9 386H sustains boosts well thanks to the 15-inch cooling headroom
2TB Gen4 SSD + SD reader suits full-time photographers

design_philosophy: The top of the 15-inch Pro 7i line: every option Lenovo offers — Ultra 9, RTX 5060, 64GB, 2TB — for creators who want Pro 9i-class internals in the more portable 15-inch Aura Edition body.
